brief:
Pre-meeting brief: Team TS3012 (before meeting d)

Built only from meetings TS3012a, TS3012b, TS3012c. Every bullet is a fact backed by verbatim, programmatically verified quotes [meeting id: "quote"] unless marked Inference or Recommendation. Speaker letters are per-meeting transcript labels.

Current decisions
- The team decided to include an LCD screen in the remote control design. Owner: Speaker A (Project Manager). [TS3012c, Speaker A: "Oh let's go for let's say because it is uh very hot in n our target group I think, we should take it take it t to consideration to build an L_C_D_ screen in it."]
- The team decided to use regular batteries as the energy source for the remote. Owner: Speaker A (Project Manager). [TS3012c, Speaker A: "energy, we choose regular regular batteries."]
- The team decided to implement voice recognition functionality in the remote. Owner: Speaker A (Project Manager). [TS3012c, Speaker A: "That's small. So we can implement it. So why why if it's small and we can imp why shouldn't we?"]

What changed along the way
- Inference: The team initially dropped the LCD screen due to power and cost concerns, but later reversed this decision to include it because it appeals to the young target group. [TS3012b, Speaker A: "I think we should lose the L_C_D_ screen, like you said."]; [TS3012c, Speaker A: "we should take it take it t to consideration to build an L_C_D_ screen in it."]

Completed work
- Speaker C presented their design concepts including energy, shape, and materials during meeting c. Owner: Speaker C (User Interface Designer). [TS3012c, Speaker C: "Let's see where my presentation is. Okay, um this I mentioned before."]
- Speaker D presented the results of the market investigation during meeting c. Owner: Speaker D (Marketing Expert). [TS3012c, Speaker D: "Okay, now it must be there. Yeah, here it is. Oh yeah. Okay, uh the investigation turns out that the most appear"]

Open actions and owners
- Speaker A was tasked with working on the year-end project report. Owner: Speaker A (Project Manager). [TS3012c, Speaker A: "I'm supposed to do the little work on the year-end report. So the project report."]

Open disagreements
- There is a disagreement regarding whether to use square or round buttons on the remote control. [TS3012c, Speaker C: "I would prefer round. But doesn't matter, doesn't matter."]

Context to remember
- The selling price was set at 25 euros with a production cost of approximately 12.5 euros. Owner: Speaker A (Project Manager). [TS3012a, Speaker A: "Selling price, twenty five Euros. That's for you. The production price, twelve and a half Euros, approximately."]
- The target demographic for the remote control is defined as younger people under forty. Owner: Speaker A (Project Manager). [TS3012b, Speaker A: "This is a new product and with this new product we want to appeal to younger people, which are um the younger people were defined under forty."]
